downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: Active installs, download queue and live disk write performance.
downloads.settingsHint: These preferences apply to all downloads
downloads.queueEmpty: No games waiting in the queue.
downloads.emptyDesc: Pick a game from your library to start downloading, then track speed and disk activity live.
ob.setupLead: Managing Epic games requires the open-source legendary tool. It is downloaded once (~45 MB).
ob.welcomeLead: Manage your Epic Games library with a high-performance, independent desktop experience in PlayStation console aesthetics.
ob.f1Desc: 120 FPS console interface with low memory usage.
ob.f2Desc: 10-foot TV/couch use with DualSense and Xbox support.
ob.f3Desc: Safe sign-in with the official Epic authorization code.
ob.linkLead: Link your Epic Games account to see your library. Choose one of two secure methods.
ob.importDesc: If the official Epic Games Launcher is installed, transfer your session without a password.
ob.codeDesc: Paste the one-time code from the Epic authorization page.
ob.verifyLead: Follow the steps below to get the one-time code and paste it.
ob.g1Desc: Sign in on the secure page with your Epic account.
ob.g2Desc: Copy the authorizationCode value from the JSON response.
ob.g3Desc: Paste the code into the field below and sign in.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Launcher configuration
settings.installDirHint: If left empty, the default is used:
settings.eglDesc: Automatically detects games installed by the official Epic Games Launcher and syncs them into efxlve launcher.
settings.eglNone: No extra games installed via Epic Games Launcher were found, or the EGL folder could not be located.
settings.thirdPartyDesc: Some Epic games require an external launcher. You can check whether they are installed here.
settings.thirdPartyRecommended: Recommended for games that require an external launcher.
settings.collectionsDesc: Import or sync your custom categories from the Epic Games Launcher ("Online", "Story", etc.).
settings.sgdbDesc: Add high-quality portrait covers (2:3) and wide hero art to your games from the SteamGridDB community platform.
settings.netDesc: Choose how much of your network and CPU the downloads may use.
settings.netMaxDesc: Targets the highest download speed using all available bandwidth and CPU cores.
settings.netLowDesc: Uses few resources in the background and avoids stutter while gaming or browsing.
settings.netBalancedDesc: Delivers ideal download speed without saturating your connection during play.
settings.offlineDesc: When you have no connection or want to stay offline, it runs the library from the local cache and launches games offline.
settings.screenshotsDesc: Customize the in-game screenshot hotkey and storage compression options.
settings.compressionDesc: Automatically compresses new screenshots, saving 70-85% of disk space.
settings.avifInfo: AVIF Technology: Thanks to modern AV1 encoding, 12-15 MB raw PNG screenshots are compressed to ~1.2 MB with no visible difference.
settings.compressionOffDesc: With compression off, screenshots are saved directly as original, uncompressed raw PNG.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the language for the launcher interface and local content.
